messages:
sara: quick ping — PR #4231 updates KMS provisioning to add audit hooks and an HSM fallback. need a security review + two approvals to merge in today's window. tests are green: https://github.com/redwood-inference/backend/pull/4231 :eyes:
kevin: on it, can you paste the tiny summary of changed behavior? especially any authz surface changes?
sara: sure — TL;DR: when we create a new key we now also register an audit hook that writes key metadata to the audit-log service; fallback path will route to HSM if KMS returns transient errors. no new external endpoints. main config diff:```yaml
kms:
  enable_audit_hook: true
  hsm_fallback: true
  audit_queue: "audit-keys-prod"
```
kevin: looks straightforward, will skim in 30m. main concern is ensuring no sensitive blobs land in the audit event (only metadata).
sophia: I'll take the review, can do deep dive in ~45. sending a quick check for secrets exposure now.
sec-bot: CI: All checks passed (unit, integration, e2e). vuln-scan: no new findings.
michael: thanks for the summary — one question: does the audit hook include key material or only descriptors (id, creator, rotation schedule)?
sara: only descriptors — code explicitly filters secret material before enqueue: `event.remove("key_material")` in enqueue path. added unit test for that.
sophia: reviewed — changed a tiny docstring and suggested a log-level tweak. LGTM from me once comment addressed.
kevin: gave a quick 👍 — added a minor nit about retry backoff comments. happy to approve after that change.
michael: approving now, left one follow-up ticket suggestion for runbook updates.
sara: awesome, thanks all. I'll merge after Kevin's approval and verify deploy in the next 15m. tagging infra on-call for a quick watch during rollout. :rocket:
